value.rationale: A motivating 2026 all-field period-divisibility conjecture was established only for q=4,8. The infinite common-displacement subclass is naturally defined by a restriction on local rule increments and contains exponentially many distinct nonlinear maps for all higher extension degrees. An exact full-state cycle census and generating zeta invariant add dynamical information unavailable from period divisibility. The restriction to one displacement is substantive, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
